summary: Tested expanded 169-agent catalogue + mention-by-short-slug. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (19 new in test_agents_catalogue.py + 15 updated in test_soulprint.py). Frontend E2E walked: landing → register → org → team → crew browse + search + division filter → New Conversation dialog (search/filter/group/auto-respond/multi-select) → group conversation page → mention picker → short-slug insert. Every reviewed feature works correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Org cards and team cards do not expose data-testid='org-card-<id>' or 'team-card-<id>'. Playwright had to fall back to clicking the only visible card by other means. Crew/dialog/conversation testids are present and correct; just the org+team list cards are missing testids.

action_items: (LOW) Add data-testid='org-card-<id>' on OrgPage org cards and 'team-card-<id>' on AppHome team cards for cleaner E2E selectors. Not blocking — UI works.

Old test_soulprint.py was updated to use new agent ids (engineering-senior-developer, marketing-content-creator, design-ui-designer, design-brand-guardian) — kept as a regression suite for auth/orgs/invites/teams/SoulPrint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 729 lines — still readable but is starting to warrant a split (auth/orgs/teams/conversations/agents) for maintainability.
_load_agents() reads the catalogue once at import time; restart is needed if agents_catalogue.json changes. Acceptable for now.

detect_mentions() correctly handles full-id, short-slug (id minus division-key), and slugified display name. Note: review_request explicitly accepts that specialized agents whose id does NOT start with their division-key (e.g. accounts-payable-agent) won't get a 'short slug' — verified in code.
team_agents endpoint correctly strips 'system' before serializing (public_agent helper). Verified in tests.
Default limit of 500 is generous; clamped between 1 and 1000 via max(1, min(limit, 1000)). Good defensive coding.
